risk.rationale: Six CONFIRMED findings (F1–F6) show repeated successful sign-ins (T1078.004) from multiple cloud/hosting ASNs (M247, Datacamp, Linode, OVH, Contabo, Hetzner) that are outside the account's baseline. The geographic/provider diversity and hosting-nature of the ASNs are consistent with a confirmed account takeover chain rather than legitimate travel or VPN use. No rejected claims or data-quality conflicts exist to explain the signals away, so this is not benign; the evidence is strong and consistent, not merely weak, so not monitor; and there is no exposure or conflicting/insufficient evidence requiring human escalation.
